states.name: Cupid
states.title: Sorceress of True Love
states.description: Whenever she senses love in the air, Cupid comes flying, forgetting all about time and place. Declarations of love, gushing about a lover, and lovers' quarrels—they all carry the sweetest scent of romance. Even now, whenever she hears someone's heart begin to race, Cupid will appear with the soft flutter of her wings.

states.name: Cupid
states.title: Sorceress of True Love
states.description: During her days at the Temple of Time, she was far more interested in her romantic fantasies than in dull lectures. Everyone saw her as an unserious student on the verge of dropping out—but in truth, she has greater potential in time magic than anyone else. The margins of her class notes are filled with unfinished love stories.

states.name: Cupid
states.title: Sorceress of True Love
states.description:
Cupid's goal was to discover the clearest example of "true love", absorb its power, and become the new Primordial of Love. And deep within an ancient dream, she found an incredibly potent love that had been lying dormant for ages.
She will stop at nothing to achieve her goal—even if it means exploiting the wishes, the pain, and the tragic fates of others.
